title: Position Sizing from Risk

launchpad.outcome: Size from the risk cap down, floor to whole contracts, and resize when the stop changes.
launchpad.missionQuestion: How many contracts fit my risk?

slides.heading: Risk first. Size second.
slides.punch: Don’t choose contracts and discover the risk. Choose the risk, then the size.

slides.title: Drop contracts in until the cap says no
slides.punch: THE STOP CHANGED. SO THE SIZE MAY NEED TO CHANGE.

slides.title: “This setup is BEAUTIFUL.” · DOUBLE SIZE?

asks.prompt: DID THE ACCOUNT’S RISK CAP CHANGE?

options.label: Yes, A+ setups earn more
options.feedback: The cap is set by the account, not the setup.

slides.punch: SETUP CONFIDENCE DOES NOT OVERRIDE THE RISK CEILING.

slides.quote: If no whole contract fits, the trade doesn’t fit the plan. The stop doesn’t shrink to make it fit.

slides.prompt: Why do you choose the risk before the size?
slides.modelAnswer: Because the account decides how much I can lose, not the setup. Risk cap ÷ risk per contract, floored to whole contracts. If the stop is wider, fewer contracts fit, and if none fit, I pass.

remember: Setup confidence does not override the risk ceiling.
